import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 解除道侣指令
 * - /解除道侣          → 提示再次发送带「确认」的指令完成解除
 * - /解除道侣 确认     → 直接执行解除
 */
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { checkBreakup, confirmBreakup } from '@src/response-apps/companion/breakup/app';
import { sendFifthLayerLockedPage } from '@src/response/access/fifthLayer';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const rawText = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const confirmed = /^[!！/#＃]?解除道侣\s+确认$/.test(rawText);

  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
  const checkResult = await checkBreakup({ messageText: e.MessageText, bid, uid, confirmed, request });
  const fifthLayerAccess = checkResult.data.access;

  if (!fifthLayerAccess.ok) {
    sendFifthLayerLockedPage({ bid, isPrivate, message, title: '解除道侣', realmName: fifthLayerAccess.realmName });

    return;
  }

  if (checkResult.code === 'NO_COMPANION') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(checkResult.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const { partnerName } = checkResult.data;

  if (!confirmed) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(`确定要与「${partnerName}」解除道侣关系吗？`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('解除后将降为普通好友，灵契值保留。');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('请发送：/解除道侣 确认');

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '',
        content: md,
        footer: [{ label: '确认解除', command: '/解除道侣 确认' }]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const result = checkResult.data.settledResult ?? (await confirmBreakup({ bid, uid, request }));
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();
  const repeatMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, request);

  md.addText(repeatMsg);

  if (result.code === 'OK') {
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(result.data.narrativeText));
  }

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
});
